name: genesis-conductor-playground
description: Genesis Conductor experimental monorepo and phase-1 delivery playground by Igor Holt (@invariantx). Integrated Cloudflare retraining worker with prompt ledger state, proposer/watchdog logic and rollback audit; typed genesis-conductor CLI as the sole write surface; read-only ChatGPT MCP app and Next.js 16 operator dashboard on shared Zod contracts; sim-first eta_thermo harness with hash-only artifact emission for thermodynamic verification. Includes local docs, ADRs, threat models, Jupyter notebooks, and full CI/deployment scaffolding. Foundational experimental surface for OpenClaw / ClawHub skill development, MCP server prototyping, autonomous agent orchestration patterns, and Genesis Conductor Engine primitives (persistent state, A2A coordination, energy-aware compute). Directly informs production bundles like openclaw-skills.
